dependency_edges.note: These are semantic evidence dependencies for universal topology generation, not a rewrite of the canonical global PO DAG and not permission to reclassify downstream RB-016 obligations as MC-B prerequisites.

implemented_bounded_subroute.input: finite independently certified complete partition of exact-rational positive-volume axis-aligned material cells
implemented_bounded_subroute.connectivity_rule: connectivity is exact positive-area face adjacency: cells share one exact boundary plane and strictly positive overlap in the other two axes
implemented_bounded_subroute.touch_rule: edge-only and point-only contact are TOUCH_ONLY and do not connect positive-volume material components
implemented_bounded_subroute.overlap_rule: pairwise positive-volume interior overlap invalidates the purported partition
implemented_bounded_subroute.identity_rule: certificate-local cell/component identifiers are not body_id or lineage_id authority
implemented_bounded_subroute.empty_rule: an independently certified complete empty partition yields exact empty material with zero components
implemented_bounded_subroute.scalar_authority: exact rationals only; floats/tolerances are forbidden

boundary_controls: exact positive-area face adjacency joins two cells
exact edge-only contact remains TOUCH_ONLY and yields separate components
exact point-only contact remains TOUCH_ONLY and yields separate components
an exact 1/1000000 positive-volume bridge changes disconnected cells into one connected component
an exact 1/1000000 positive gap preserves disconnected components
multiple disconnected components are enumerated canonically independent of input order
an independently certified exact empty partition yields zero components without placeholder identity
pairwise positive-volume interior overlap is rejected
binary-float/scientific/tolerance coordinates are rejected as exact authority
stale or mismatched source/material/event/configuration/frame/revision binding is rejected
a forged complete=true assertion without the independent completeness certificate contract is rejected
